$comment: Water flow (docs/WATER_FLOW.md, ADR 0053): basins with one level joined by outlets. Rates are real and counted in game time (the day/night clock's: a 20-minute day is 72x real time) x the world's water speed (`speed`, the default of the server's `water_speed`). tickEvery: server ticks per water tick. liveRadiusM: basins within it of a player are simulated, the rest wait. maxBasinCells: a body of water bigger than this (the sea, a large lake) is a fixed reservoir at its level until W2. maxRowCells: a row spreading wider (a sheet over a plain) caps the basin there, the excess lost. streamReach: how far (cells) water running over flat ground looks for a way down before it pools. mergeSeconds: two basins sharing faces merge when the faces would even their levels out within this (water s) and carry what flows through them within 2 cm: a wide gap is one body, a hole in a wall an opening between two. About the shortest flow step the water affords (a tick is up to 64 steps). streamMinFlow: a spill passing at least this over a body's edge (m3/s; 0.05 is a sheet ~7 cm deep over a weir) is drawn running, over its crest and down its way as its liquid's `running` block: every outlet carrying at least a sixteenth of it, so a spill shared out over a wide edge runs as a whole. catchUpSteps: the most flow steps a water tick spends bringing basins that waited (out of reach, unloaded) forward by the time they waited, the rest the next tick (each step as long as the basin affords; one in balance is caught up at once). settleMmPerHour: a basin whose level moves slower than this (mm an hour of water time) is settled; one filling or draining faster flows on with no player near, its chunks kept loaded, until it settles. riverSpeed: how fast a change to a river's flow (a dam holding it back, a lake let go) travels down the world map's rivers through country nobody has loaded (m/s of water time); riverChangeMin: the least change (m3/s) a body sends down its river, and riverChangeShare the least share of its river's flow (a large river's level wobbles by more than a small one's flow), lasting riverChangeHoldS (water s; a pool settling is no change downstream, a dam filling is); lakeOutletHead: a map lake's head over its outlet (m), so its outflow follows a change coming in over its area x this / (1.5 x its outflow) s. fillHysteresis: how far past half a step (in its liquid's fill steps) a body's level must move before its surface is drawn at another fill, so a level hovering at a step (or a row's floor) doesn't flicker between them. liquids: each liquid block's weir coefficient (m^0.5/s; an outlet passes weir x width x head^1.5). leaks: how much a block lets through (m3/s per m2 of face per m of head; a hydraulic conductivity over a 1 m block); a block not listed is sealed. Run `node shared/fluids/gen.mjs` after editing; CI fails if crates/dwell-world/src/flow.gen.rs is stale.
